name: Kermit Looking Out the Window
look: A photo of Kermit the Frog at a rainy window. He stands on the right with one arm raised, head turned as he gazes out through glass dotted with raindrops. The background is a soft gray blur and the mood is gloomy and wistful.
use: Kermit stands in for someone waiting, longing or quietly sulking. The caption says what he is waiting for or missing, like summer, a text back or the weekend, or a gloomy thought he is having.
slots: what he is waiting for or thinking about (caption above the picture)
examples: Me watching the rain on the one day I planned to go outside
Me waiting for the delivery that has been "two minutes away" for twenty minutes
describe: kermit the frog staring out a rainy window sadly
frog puppet looking through window with raindrops
kermit gazing outside waiting for something on a gloomy day
green muppet alone by wet glass looking out
sad frog watching the rain fall from inside
origin: A photo of Kermit the Frog posed looking out a window on a rainy day.
